query:
The group regularly does a shared meal before dark-sky sessions — Cecilia organises these and they seem like part of the tradition. Does this actually apply to all members? If not, who opts out and how does the chat show this?

Options:
A. Jerome
B. Tomás
C. Ruth
D. Marcus
context:
[1] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:36:00) ok back to Feb 17th logistics, do we want to do the group meal first or go straight to site? I was thinking Thai takeaway at mine at 6:30 then car share to Blackmoor by 8? 🍜🌟
[2] (about=Jerome, episodic, t2 @2026-02-06T20:38:00) I will go straight to site. I need to be set up and aligned by 7:45 to make the most of the window. dinner beforehand doesn't work with my acquisition schedule.
[3] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t4 @2026-03-06T20:07:00) 65 miles is a big ask on a Friday night, accessibility matters if we want everyone to come. Blackmoor is 40 mins and people actually show up!!! I love a dark site but we already have good turn-outs at Blackmoor 🌟
[4] (about=Ruth, episodic, t4 @2026-03-06T20:10:00) Is it possible that we compromise, perhaps one deeper-dark-sky session per season for those who want it, with Blackmoor remaining the default? That way nobody is left out on the regular outings.
[5] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:32:00) ok ok I hear you both, maybe we do need to do one proper dark-sky trip this summer. I'll organise it!!! Two-hour drive is doable if we make a weekend of it and get accommodation 🌟✨
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:33:00) i'm in for a weekend trip, though for planets i still don't need bortle 2 lol. but i won't say no to a weekend away
[7] (about=Cecilia, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:35:00) everyone is in for September then!!! I'll send the formal group announcement Monday with three days notice, Nadia and Ruth as usual you want to co-sign the session note?!!! 🌟🌟🌟
[8] (about=Ruth, episodic, t0 @2026-01-09T20:50:00) Nadia and I will sort the session reminder on Monday as usual. We will aim for 8pm arrive, first light by 8:30.
[9] (about=Harriet, episodic, t6 @2026-04-03T20:24:00) Marathon night confirmed then. I'll put a reminder in the group. Nadia and Ruth, can you send the formal session note Monday as usual? Three days notice minimum for the site.
[10] (about=Priya, episodic, t14 @2026-08-07T20:30:00) speaking of the group: can we agree on next session dates? September new moon is the 22nd and conditions look favourable already 🔭
[11] (about=Harriet, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:40:00) I want to do an episode built around that weekend. The group, the dark sky, the contrast between people seeing it for the first time and veterans like Nadia who have been chasing this for thirty years. Dev, your reaction on the night would be perfect audio.
[12] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:38:00) dev and I stayed up till 3am watching jupiter and saturn transit. the seeing came up to 4/5 around 1am and at 400x on jupiter you could see three festoons in the NEB simultaneously. that's the best planetary night I've had in two years
[13] (about=Nadia, episodic, t8 @2026-05-08T20:31:00) I have been saying this since session one. In my experience there is no substitute for genuine darkness. The Milky Way shadow phenomenon happens around SQM 22.0 or above. You cannot replicate it closer to town, full stop.
[14] (about=Ruth, episodic, t10 @2026-06-05T20:44:00) In favour. Though I would note that for a pure double-star session on a steady night, Blackmoor is still adequate. Seeing matters more than darkness for splitting tight pairs.
